infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WRV Energies uses the camera to photograph your electricity bill so the details can be read from it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WRV Energies needs access to your photos so you can pick a saved bill image.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: WRV Energies uses your location to detect your region for energy monitoring.
